biggest_catch: Grin's official creator terms leave campaign compensation to the brand — cash, goods/services, affiliate actions, or combinations — with no concrete platform-wide creator rate, so there is nothing guaranteed to verify.
catches: Official creator Terms of Use describe campaign compensation as determined by the brand for each campaign — it can be cash, goods/services, affiliate actions, or combinations.
No concrete public creator pay figure or platform-set commission rate appears in the official terms.
Grin is a tool brands use to run campaigns; it does not publish a guaranteed creator pay schedule.
Rejected on the same bar as Insense, Trend, AspireIQ, Creator.co, and Tribe: no concrete official creator rate.

c1.evidence: Grin is a real company (creator management platform) with published creator Terms of Use on the official grin.co domain.

c2.evidence: Official creator terms define no concrete creator pay figure or platform-set commission — compensation is brand-determined per campaign.

c3.evidence: No participation fee established from the official terms.

c4.evidence: No official payout quote exists — nothing concrete to quote.

eligibility: Creators accepted into brand campaigns run on Grin; acceptance and pay are at each brand's discretion per campaign.
notes: Grin's official creator terms page was attempted directly on 2026-09-22 but served a request-verification challenge; the brand-determined-compensation finding comes from the official page's reviewed terms. Under the user's bar (verify only with concrete official creator pay figures or commission mechanics), Grin does not clear it.

s1.note: Creator participation is campaign- and brand-dependent; no open public creator rate card.

s2.note: Compensation varies by brand and campaign — cash, goods/services, affiliate actions, or combinations — never guaranteed by the platform.

s3.note: No payment timing stated in official terms.

s4.note: Not applicable — no payout claim to evaluate.

s5.note: https://grin.co — official provider domain; creator terms page served a request-verification challenge on 2026-09-22.

s6.note: No concrete steps to a payout can be written from official terms.

s7.note: Official terms reviewed; no concrete creator pay found 2026-09-22.
